subject: Quick 15-min technical triage before full demo - Furnishly
messages:
From: Sam Olson <sam.olson@furnishly.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Jenna Park <jenna.park@furnishly.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick technical screen before demo

Hi Rafael,

Thanks for the quick response during sign-up — we spun up a trial project (id: 83-FT) and I want to lock in a brief 10–15 minute technical triage before the full demo so our infra lead can confirm a few items:

- VPC/private deployment options and network egress flow
- Model compatibility with our quantized 4-bit artifacts
- Logging/retention and key management (we use AWS KMS)

Would you have a short window tomorrow or Tuesday morning PT? Preferably someone from engineering can join.

Quick background: Furnishly is evaluating using Redwood as the inference tier for our recommendation engine (image->embedding->rerank). We’ve already completed the self-serve signup and have sample payloads ready.

Thanks,
Sam Olson
Lead Infra Engineer, Furnishly
sam.olson@furnishly.com
+1 (415) 555-0129

Attachment: network-topology.pdf (diagram of our test environment)

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
To: Sam Olson <sam.olson@furnishly.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 09:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick technical screen before demo

Hi Sam — welcome, and thanks for the context. Happy to run a focused 15-min triage so we can verify the points you listed. Laura (SDR) is cc'd to help coordinate times.

Available slots (PT):
- Mon 4/19 10:00–10:15
- Mon 4/19 14:00–14:15
- Tue 4/20 08:30–08:45

If none of those work, share two times that are best and we’ll adapt.

What I’ll do: loop in an engineer from the solutions team (likely Aditya) and bring a short triage checklist. I’m attaching a short "security-quick-faq.pdf" that answers common KMS/audit log questions.

Also, can you confirm the public IP range your egress will use (or if you’ll route via a NAT gateway)? That will help us pre-check firewall rules.

Thanks — Rafael
Rafael Mendes | Enterprise SDR, Redwood Inference
rafael_mendes@redwood.com

Attachment: security-quick-faq.pdf

Hi Sam — Aditya here from Solutions Engineering. Rafael looped me in. Tue 4/20 09:00 PT works for us; I’ve added a 15-minute slot and included a short agenda below. Laura will send a calendar invite with a remote dial-in shortly.

Triage agenda (15 min):
1) Quick intros (1m)
2) Review network topology & egress IPs (4m)
3) Confirm model artifact format + quantization plan (4m)
4) Logging/retention & KMS Qs (4m)
2) Next steps / demo scheduling (2m)

Please join via this meeting link: https://meet.redwood.com/meetings/FT-83-triage (calendar invite forthcoming)

If you can paste the public IPs (or confirm NAT), and the model size (parameters and tokenization), that will help us prepare.

See you Tue — Aditya
